serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Huh? Home, I’m going home.
Policewoman: I will drive you back.
You: Thanks, but I live not too far away from here, I can walk. I don’t want to bother you any more than I already have.
#Policewoman.Face.annoyed
Policewoman: I insist.
You: O-ok then?
You: So, what happens now?
Policewoman: Huh? W-what do you mean?
She got flustered all of sudden…
You: I was asking about the investigation…
Policewoman: Right…
You: Where are we going? My home is the other way around.
Policewoman: Yeah, sorry about that. I need to pick something up first.
You: Ok?
What’s her deal? Is this some kind of revenge?
